t: Excellent quality Bahco 9031 wide jaw adjustable wrench delivers strong, accurate fastening for general plumbing, maintenance and installation tasks. Built from hardened chrome vanadium steel with a phosphate finish, it provides durability and corrosion resistance in daily trade use. Features comfortable ergonomic handle for improved grip and control, wide profile groove for easy knurl adjustment and easy-to-read, laser-etched measurement scale for quick, precise adjustment. Slimline jaws allow use in confined spaces, making the wrench suitable for plumbers, fitters and DIY work in tight areas.
b: Laser-Etched Scale For Quick Size Adjustment
Smooth Knurl For Easy Jaw Adjustment
Compact 200mm Length For Tool Bag Storage
